_comment: Default bch-bot configuration. The treasury address below receives the 0.5% per-tx fee when configured. Change it to your own address if you fork the wallet. Set treasuryBps to 0 to disable the fee entirely.
_treasuryMinSats_comment: Skip the fee output entirely if computed fee < this many sats (avoids dust outputs)
_treasuryRoundingRule_comment: How to round fractional sat amounts: 'floor' (undercharge user) or 'ceil' (overcharge). Floor is user-friendly and is what most exchanges do.
